subject: Post-call: Procurement path, MAP & PO vs Card confirmation
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@procureco.com>, James O'Neal <james.oneal@procureco.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + suggested MAP and timeline (PO vs card)

Hi Alyssa / James —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so we keep momentum through legal, security, and finance. I captured the procurement options you asked about and a conservative timeline.

Key takeaways from the call:
- You prefer to use a PO for enterprise billing but want the option to start with a card for a short pilot.
- Internal reviewers: Legal (contract redlines), Security (questionnaire + SOC2 artifacts), Finance (PO issuance & vendor setup).
- Marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace) was discussed as a longer-term option if you need catalog/centralized billing.

Proposed MAP (owners & target dates):
1) Legal review of MPA draft — procureco legal: 5 business days (owner: Alyssa) — target: 2026-09-21
2) Security questionnaire & evidence exchange — ProcureCo Sec + Redwood Sec (owner: James / Karthik) — target: 2026-09-24
3) Finance vendor setup & PO issuance — ProcureCo Finance (owner: Alyssa) — target: 2026-09-30
4) Pilot start (card or PO depending on pace) — target start: 2026-10-05

Notes on commercial path options:
- Card first: fastest to start (2–3 business days), limited to lower initial spend, easier for a 2–4 week pilot.
- PO: preferred for enterprise procurement; expect 2–3 weeks for vendor setup and internal approvals unless finance expedites.
- Marketplace: adds procurement speed for future renewals but requires marketplace listing coordination (we can run this in parallel).

I've attached a draft MAP spreadsheet and a short summary of the PO vs card trade-offs for your procurement team.

Would you be comfortable owning Legal + Finance deadlines on your side, and can we plan a 15-minute check-in next Friday 9/18 to confirm progress? If so I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-v0.9.xlsx (MAP draft), ProcureCo-PO-process-summary.pdf (one-pager)
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@procureco.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: James O'Neal <james.oneal@procureco.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + suggested MAP and timeline (PO vs card)

Thanks Soojin — good summary. Alyssa here (ProcureCo, procurement lead). A couple clarifications from our side:

- We'll aim to review the MPA this week but legal runs triage on Thursdays, so I expect formal feedback by 2026-09-21.
- Security will need the questionnaire you mentioned plus any SOC2 scoped artifacts. Can Karthik share the list of specific files we should expect?
- Finance prefers PO for production, but they allow card for short pilots up to $10k. We'll try to move vendor setup in parallel with legal to avoid serial delays.

I'll own Legal + Finance on our side and coordinate with James for security evidence. 9/18 11:00 PT works for a quick sync — please send invite.

Alyssa Turner
Head of Strategic Procurement, ProcureCo
alyssa.turner@procureco.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@procureco.com>, James O'Neal <james.oneal@procureco.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + suggested MAP and timeline (PO vs card)

Hi Alyssa / James —

Thanks for the quick reply. To make security triage easy, here is what we plan to share immediately:
- Completed security questionnaire (standard vendor questionnaire) — PDF export
- SOC2 Type II summary (scope, date) — one-page summary (SOC2-evidence-summary.txt)
- Network diagram & data flow (S3 endpoint, VPC setup) — we can send a redacted version on request

If you can confirm which questionnaire template ProcureCo uses (or share it), we'll fill and return within 2 business days. For marketplace: we can open conversations about AWS Marketplace but would recommend finishing the MPA + pilot first.

I'll attach the short SOC2 bullets to this thread and will follow up in the 9/18 check-in with any outstanding items.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Great — thanks team. Calendar invite sent for 9/18 11:00 PT with the MAP attached (Redwood-MAP-v0.9.xlsx). A couple quick operational asks before the call so we can hit targets:

- Alyssa: will you confirm ProcureCo's legal reviewer name and whether redlines need to be shared via DocuSign or as annotated PDF?
- James: if you can point me to the questionnaire (or drop it in reply), Karthik will fill and return within 48 hours.
- Laura (cc): can you prepare a short vendor-setup checklist we can share with ProcureCo finance, including Redwood's remit details and tax info?

If Legal gives a faster-than-expected turnaround we'll accelerate the PO path; otherwise we treat card pilot as a fallback so ProcureCo can get hands-on quickly.

See you Friday.

Thanks,
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
